notes.subject: מגדלות
notes.rationale: 'Towers of perfumes' (megadlot) vs KJV's 'sweet flowers' (read as מגדלות from נגד); JPS 'banks of sweet herbs'; literal 'towers/raised beds' kept.

notes.subject: מור עובר
notes.rationale: 'Myrrh that passes/flows' — mor echoes the root of 'distilling'; the dripping-motion pun is lost.

notes.subject: mor
notes.rationale: מור (myrrh, a bitter gum resin) kept as transliteration; no Bamanankan perfume-word matches its resin-distilling sense.

translation: A ɲɛdaw ye nakɔ-yɔrɔw ye minnu bɛ ni nɔnabolo-finw ye, minnu jɔra i n'a fɔ jɔnbaw ye; a da-nɔgɔnw ye susunw ye, minnu bɛ mor tigɛ ka taa.
